How Much Does a Custom Kitchen Cost in Tampa?

PalmCraft custom kitchens start from $10,000. Every project gets a full itemized quote upfront, so you see materials, hardware, and installation before you commit, with no hidden fees.

What affects the price

  • Size of the room and total cabinet run
  • Door style: American shaker or European flat-panel
  • Materials, colors, and finishes
  • Organizers, pull-outs, and specialty hardware
  • Installation scope and site conditions

How it works

  1. Request & Consultation. Send the short form or call. We discuss your room, style, and budget, and you get a response within 24 hours. The estimate is free and carries no obligation.
  2. Measurements & Design. We measure your space for free, review the layout, and prepare a free 3D design with materials, colors, and hardware for your approval.
  3. Production. After final design approval and the first deposit, production takes up to 6 weeks. Cabinets are ready for your inspection before delivery.
  4. Delivery & Installation. PalmCraft delivers and professionally installs its own cabinetry across Tampa Bay, finishing with a hardware check and cleanup.
